= BITwiki Quality Standards: Content Excellence Framework =

== Executive Summary

This document defines quality standards for BITwiki content across four dimensions: epistemic, structural, linguistic, and recursive. All content must meet these standards to be considered complete.

'''Quality Dimensions:'''
# '''Epistemic:''' Truth, evidence, confidence
# '''Structural:''' Organization, completeness, SMW
# '''Linguistic:''' Clarity, precision, style
# '''Recursive:''' Self-reference, consistency, integration

----
== 1. Epistemic Quality

=== 1.1 Truth Standards

'''Accuracy:'''
* Claims must be verifiable
* Sources must support claims
* No fabricated information
* Corrections made promptly

'''Precision:'''
* Specific numbers, not vague quantities
* Defined terms, not ambiguous language
* Clear scope, not overgeneralization
* Explicit limitations

'''Objectivity:'''
* Multiple perspectives represented
* Bias acknowledged explicitly
* Evidence over opinion
* Falsification conditions stated

=== 1.2 Evidence Standards

| Tier | Requirement | Minimum Sources |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| '''Axiomatic''' | Self-evident | 0 |
| '''Established''' | Primary + consensus | 5+ (T1/T2) |
| '''Emerging''' | Secondary sources | 3+ (T2/T3) |
| '''Hypothetical''' | Limited evidence | 1+ (any) |
| '''Contested''' | Multiple viewpoints | 2+ (conflicting) |

'''Citation Requirements:'''
* All empirical claims cited
* Sources accessible (URLs, DOIs)
* Evidence tiers marked
* Full bibliographic information

=== 1.3 Confidence Calibration

'''Calibration Standards:'''

| Stated | Expected Accuracy | Tolerance |
|--------|-------------------|-----------|
| 0.95-1.0 | 95-100% | ±3% |
| 0.80-0.94 | 80-94% | ±7% |
| 0.60-0.79 | 60-79% | ±10% |
| 0.40-0.59 | 40-59% | ±15% |
| <0.40 | <40% | ±20% |

'''Red Flags:'''
* Confidence >0.9 without primary sources
* All claims by author >0.85
* Confidence never changes
* No falsification conditions

----
== 2. Structural Quality

=== 2.1 Document Structure

'''Required Elements:'''

| Element | Required | Purpose |
|---------|----------|---------|
| YAML Frontmatter | Yes | Metadata, epistemic markers |
| Document Header | Yes | Title, author, date |
| Introduction | Yes | Context, scope |
| Body Content | Yes | Main information |
| See Also | Recommended | Related content |
| References | If cited | Source attribution |
| Categories | Yes | Organization |

'''Section Requirements:'''
* Logical flow
* Clear headings
* Appropriate depth
* No orphan sections

=== 2.2 YAML Frontmatter

'''Required Fields:'''

| Field | Type | Validation |
|-------|------|------------|
| `title` | Text | Non-empty, <100 chars |
| `description` | Text | Non-empty, <500 chars |
| `type` | Text | Valid entity type |
| `author` | Text | Non-empty |
| `created` | Date | ISO 8601 format |
| `version` | Text | Semantic versioning |
| `epistemic_status` | Text | Valid status |
| `confidence` | Number | 0.0-1.0 |

'''Optional Fields:'''
* `ontology` (entity_type, domain)
* `workflow` (state, review_date)
* `license` (SPDX identifier)
* `sources` (URL list)

=== 2.3 SMW Integration

'''Property Requirements:'''
* `[[Has title::...]]` set
* `[[Has entity type::...]]` set
* `[[Has confidence::...]]` set
* `[[Has epistemic status::...]]` set
* `[[Has author::...]]` set
* `[[Has creation date::...]]` set

'''Query Requirements:'''
* At least one inline query OR
* Template that generates queries
* Query results display correctly

=== 2.4 Template Usage

'''Required Templates:'''
* `{{Document_Header}}` OR
* `{{Epistemic_Marker}}` OR
* Equivalent custom template

'''Template Standards:'''
* All parameters documented
* No broken template calls
* Proper nesting
* Valid syntax

----
== 3. Linguistic Quality

=== 3.1 Clarity Standards

'''Readability:'''
* Flesch Reading Ease: 40-60 (standard)
* Flesch-Kincaid Grade: 10-14
* Sentence length: <25 words average
* Paragraph length: <150 words

'''Accessibility:'''
* Define technical terms
* Explain acronyms
* Use examples
* Avoid jargon

'''Structure:'''
* Active voice preferred
* Parallel structure
* Logical progression
* Clear transitions

=== 3.2 Precision Standards

'''Word Choice:'''
* Specific over general
* Concrete over abstract
* Technical terms defined
* No weasel words

'''Quantification:'''
* Numbers over "many"
* Percentages over "most"
* Ranges over "about"
* Confidence intervals

'''Scope:'''
* Explicit boundaries
* Clear limitations
* No overgeneralization
* Context provided

=== 3.3 Style Standards

'''Tone:'''
* Neutral and objective
* Professional
* Respectful
* Accessible

'''Voice:'''
* Active preferred
* Third person
* Consistent tense
* Appropriate register

'''Formatting:'''
* Consistent headings
* Proper punctuation
* Standard spelling
* Correct grammar

----
== 4. Recursive Quality

=== 4.1 Self-Reference

'''Internal Links:'''
* Link to related concepts
* Cross-reference definitions
* Connect to principles
* Reference constitution

'''External Links:'''
* Primary sources
* Authoritative references
* Accessible URLs
* Stable links

'''Navigation:'''
* See Also section
* Category membership
* Template inclusion
* Query results

=== 4.2 Consistency

'''Terminology:'''
* Consistent definitions
* Standardized terms
* No contradictory usage
* Glossary alignment

'''Formatting:'''
* Consistent templates
* Standard structure
* Uniform style
* Predictable patterns

'''Epistemics:'''
* Consistent confidence
* Appropriate status
* Matching evidence
* Logical progression

=== 4.3 Integration

'''Ontology Alignment:'''
* Correct entity type
* Appropriate domain
* Valid relationships
* Proper categorization

'''System Integration:'''
* SMW properties set
* Queries functional
* Templates render
* Categories assigned

'''Community Integration:'''
* Follows conventions
* Respects precedents
* Compatible with existing
* Extends knowledge base

----
== 5. Quality Metrics

=== 5.1 Scoring System

| Dimension | Weight | Max Score |
|-----------|--------|-----------|
| Epistemic | 30% | 30 |
| Structural | 25% | 25 |
| Linguistic | 25% | 25 |
| Recursive | 20% | 20 |
| '''Total''' | '''100%''' | '''100''' |

'''Quality Levels:'''

| Score | Level | Badge |
|-------|-------|-------|
| 95-100 | Exceptional | ⭐⭐⭐ |
| 85-94 | Excellent | ⭐⭐ |
| 75-84 | Good | ⭐ |
| 60-74 | Adequate | ✅ |
| 40-59 | Needs Work | 🔄 |
| <40 | Incomplete | 📝 |

=== 5.2 Automated Checks

'''Epistemic:'''
* Confidence score present
* Status assigned
* Sources cited
* Falsification stated

'''Structural:'''
* YAML frontmatter valid
* Required fields present
* SMW properties set
* Categories assigned

'''Linguistic:'''
* Readability score
* Grammar check
* Spell check
* Link validation

'''Recursive:'''
* Internal links
* Cross-references
* Template usage
* Query functionality

=== 5.3 Manual Review

'''Steward Review:'''
* Content accuracy
* Epistemic appropriateness
* Structural completeness
* Style consistency

'''Peer Review:'''
* Expert validation
* Community feedback
* Suggestion incorporation
* Consensus building

----
== 6. Quality Improvement

=== 6.1 Continuous Improvement

'''Regular Review:'''
* Annual quality audit
* Confidence recalibration
* Source verification
* Link checking

'''Version Control:'''
* Track changes
* Document rationale
* Maintain history
* Enable rollback

'''Feedback Integration:'''
* User suggestions
* Error reports
* Improvement requests
* Community input

=== 6.2 Remediation

'''Minor Issues:'''
* Fix immediately
* Document in edit summary
* No review required

'''Major Issues:'''
* Flag for review
* Notify steward
* Timeline for fix
* Verification required

'''Critical Issues:'''
* Immediate attention
* Content may be removed
* Root cause analysis
* Process improvement

----
== 7. Quality Assurance Process

=== 7.1 Pre-Publication

'''Author Checklist:'''
* [ ] YAML frontmatter complete
* [ ] Epistemic markers added
* [ ] Sources cited
* [ ] SMW properties set
* [ ] Categories assigned
* [ ] Links verified
* [ ] Grammar checked
* [ ] Readability acceptable

'''Automated Validation:'''
* YAML validation
* SMW property check
* Link validation
* Template syntax check

=== 7.2 Publication Review

'''Steward Review:'''
* Quality assessment
* Epistemic validation
* Structural review
* Approval decision

'''Community Review:'''
* Open comment period
* Feedback collection
* Revision if needed
* Final approval

=== 7.3 Post-Publication

'''Monitoring:'''
* Quality metrics
* User feedback
* Error reports
* Usage analytics

'''Maintenance:'''
* Regular updates
* Confidence recalibration
* Source verification
* Link maintenance

----
== Conclusion

Quality in BITwiki is multi-dimensional and continuous. These standards ensure content meets the highest epistemic and structural requirements while remaining accessible and useful.

'''Key Principles:'''
* Epistemic rigor
* Structural completeness
* Linguistic clarity
* Recursive integration
* Continuous improvement

'''Next Steps:'''
# Apply standards to all content
# Implement automated checks
# Train contributors
# Monitor quality metrics
# Iterate and improve
